# Tahira Syndicate — Full Knowledge Base & Technical Directory

> Comprehensive plain-text documentation of Tahira Syndicate's industrial product catalog, material specifications, fabrication services, and corporate directory.

## About the Company

Tahira Syndicate is a premier direct manufacturer, importer, and master distributor of high-performance industrial polymers, ropes, netting, tarpaulins, piping, and cargo-control equipment based in Karachi, Pakistan. Serving industrial contractors, maritime operations, agricultural developments, and infrastructure projects across Sindh and Pakistan for decades.

- **Headquarters & Warehouse**: Shop # 1, Thakurdwara Ln, Main Shahra-e-Liaquat Road, opp. Sindh Madarsa-tul-Islam, Searl Quarters, Karachi, 74000, Pakistan.
- **Sales & Wholesale Orders (WhatsApp / Call)**: +92 321 2043552
- **Website**: https://tahirasyndicate.com
- **Business Model**: Direct B2B Wholesale & Master Distribution (Price on Request via WhatsApp RFQ).

## Complete Product Catalog & Technical Specifications

### 1. Ropes & Industrial Cordage (https://tahirasyndicate.com/categories/ropes)
- **Polypropylene (PP) Danline 3-Strand Ropes**: High-tenacity virgin polypropylene floating ropes resistant to saltwater, acids, and UV degradation. Diameters: 4mm to 48mm. Breaking strengths up to 32,000 kgf. Ideal for marine mooring, shipping vessels, construction rigging, and industrial transport.
- **Manila Natural Fiber Ropes (Jahazi Rassa)**: 100% Grade-A abaca natural fibers. Diameters: 6mm to 64mm. Low stretch, high heat resistance, non-sparking, ideal for marine pilot ladders, scaffolding, and gym climbing.
- **Braided Nylon Cords & Ropes**: High-shock-absorption polyamide multi-braid ropes. Diameters: 2mm to 24mm. High elasticity and abrasion resistance.
- **Marine Pilot Ladders & Gangway Ropes**: SOLAS-certified hardwood rung pilot ladders rigged with natural manila ropes.

### 2. Agricultural, Construction & Safety Netting (https://tahirasyndicate.com/categories/nets)
- **UV-Stabilized Agro Green Shade Netting (Hara Parda)**: 100% virgin HDPE monofilament knitted mesh with 5-year UV stabilization. Shade factors: 50%, 75%, 85%, and 90%. Roll widths: 2m, 3m, 4m, 6m; roll lengths: 50m, 100m. Used for agricultural greenhouses, nursery shading, cattle farms, rooftop heat insulation, and building scaffolding enclosures.
- **Heavy-Duty Construction Safety Netting**: Debris containment mesh and fall-protection safety nets for high-rise building projects.
- **Sports & Anti-Bird Netting**: Knotless HDPE barrier netting for cricket practice pitches, football goal cages, tennis courts, and pigeon anti-bird balcony protection.

### 3. Polyester Webbing Slings & Cargo Control (https://tahirasyndicate.com/categories/safety-belts-webbing-slings)
- **Endless & Eye-to-Eye Polyester Webbing Slings**: Manufactured according to EN 1492-1 standards. Capacity: 1 Ton (Violet), 2 Ton (Green), 3 Ton (Yellow), 5 Ton (Red), 8 Ton (Blue), 10 Ton (Orange). Safety factor 6:1 or 7:1.
- **Heavy-Duty Ratchet Cargo Lashing Belts**: 25mm, 35mm, 50mm, and 75mm industrial tie-down belts with forged steel double J-hooks and zinc-plated tensioners. Capacities: 1 Ton to 10 Ton.
- **Full Body Fall-Arrest Harnesses**: OSHA/CE compliant polyester harnesses with dual-lanyard shock absorbers and scaffold snap hooks.

### 4. Waterproof Tarpaulins & Canvas Tents (https://tahirasyndicate.com/categories/tarpaulins-canvas-tents)
- **Multi-Layer Cross-Laminated HDPE Tarpaulins (Tarpal)**: 100% waterproof, tear-resistant, lightweight tarpaulins with heat-sealed seams, reinforced corners, and rust-proof aluminum eyelets every 3 feet. GSM options: 120 GSM, 180 GSM, 250 GSM, 350 GSM. Available in blue, green, silver, and dual-tone.
- **Heavy-Duty Wax-Treated Cotton Canvas Tarpaulins (Moom Tarpal)**: Breathable, water-repellent heavy duck canvas for transport truck covers, military field shelters, and machinery storage. Weights: 10oz, 14oz, 18oz, 24oz per sq yard.
- **Emergency Relief & Refugee Canvas Tents**: Ridge and marquee canvas emergency shelters with galvanized steel frame tubing. Standard sizes: 4m x 4m, 5m x 4m.

### 5. Flexible Hoses & Industrial Piping (https://tahirasyndicate.com/categories/building-flexible-pipes)
- **Heliflex PVC Spiral Suction & Delivery Hoses**: Rigid PVC spiral-reinforced flexible hose for water delivery, heavy drainage, deep-well boring extraction, and chemical transfers. Diameters: 1 inch to 8 inches.
- **Cotton PVC Braided Flexible Garden & Discharge Tubing**: Flexible transparent PVC tubing with polyester fiber braid.
- **uPVC & HDPE Pressure Pipes**: Class B, C, D, E water supply and agricultural bore pipes.

### 6. Plastic Polymers & Raw Materials (https://tahirasyndicate.com/categories/polythene-sheets-films)
- **Polyethylene (PE) Raw Materials**: High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE blow/film/pipe grade), Low-Density Polyethylene (LDPE), and Linear Low-Density Polyethylene (LLDPE).
- **Polypropylene (PP) Raw Materials**: Raffia grade, injection molding grade, and extrusion copolymer granules (plastic daana).
- **Construction Polythene Sheets & Moisture Barriers**: Virgin and recycled Dhalai shopper rolls (transparent, black, blue) in widths up to 12 feet.

### 7. Industrial Strapping & Packaging (https://tahirasyndicate.com/categories/packaging-strapping)
- **Polypropylene (PP) Box Strapping Rolls**: Semi-automatic and fully automatic machine strapping bands (9mm, 12mm, 15mm, 19mm).
- **High-Tensile Polyester (PET) Strapping**: Steel-strap replacement with high elasticity and shock retention.
- **Metal Strapping Clips & Seals (Patti Kundi)**: Serrated zinc-galvanized clips for heavy carton and pallet binding.

---

## Installation & On-Site Rigging Services

Tahira Syndicate provides end-to-end site surveying, steel fabrication, and tensile fabric/netting installation across Pakistan:
1. **Commercial Tensile Canopies & Parking Sheds**: Custom engineered membrane canopies with zero center columns.
2. **School & College Sports Netting**: Full perimeter and overhead cage enclosures for cricket pitches, football grounds, and basketball courts.
3. **High-Rise Rooftop Agro Shade Structure Installations**: Heat reduction and UV protection frameworks.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q: Where is Tahira Syndicate located?**
A: Shop # 1, Thakurdwara Lane, Main Shahra-e-Liaquat Road, opposite Sindh Madarsa-tul-Islam, Searl Quarters, Karachi, Pakistan.

**Q: How can I get bulk wholesale pricing?**
A: Contact the sales desk directly via WhatsApp at +92 321 2043552 or visit our warehouse for on-site samples and quotation sheets.

**Q: Do you ship outside Karachi?**
A: Yes. We arrange daily bulk freight dispatches to Lahore, Faisalabad, Multan, Rawalpindi, Islamabad, Peshawar, Quetta, Sukkur, Hyderabad, and all industrial zones across Pakistan.

**Q: What are your operating hours?**
A: Monday through Saturday from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM PKT.
